title: Book Two · Chapter 88: Enough Paper for Everyone
story:
In early summer, Miss Wu asks a small group to prepare paper for a reading activity. Each child will fold one sheet. They will write a short answer inside. Ronan, Jun and two others help before lunch.

Jun counts the sheets. Ronan counts the desks. Each row has the same number of desks. But one desk is empty today.

“We need one less,” Ronan says.

Miss Wu asks them to leave a sheet at the empty desk too. Its owner may return after lunch. Ronan adds one to his number.

The sheets are different sizes. Some are clean on both sides. Others have old work on the back. Ronan begins to put the largest sheets at the front desks.

Jun watches him. “Will they fold the same way?”

Ronan looks at the two sizes in his hand. He wants to keep moving. The pile is heavy. The others are already waiting for more.

“We can fold them,” he says.

He tries one small sheet. It makes a narrow little book. The large sheet makes a much wider one.

Miss Wu comes over. She checks the pile and gives them one size for everyone. The children can draw on the other sheets later. Ronan puts his first pile back and starts again.

Now he makes small groups of five on the table. Jun carries one group to each row. The two other children lay them out. There is one extra group at the end.

“We counted too many,” Ronan says.

Jun checks the empty desk and then the back row. A group of five is still in Ronan's hand. He counted it on the table. Then he picked it up and counted it again.

He sets it aside. The desk count is right. Miss Wu asks each helper to check one row. Ronan walks down his row and touches the corner of each sheet. Everyone has one.

After lunch, the child returns to the empty desk. The sheet is waiting there. Ronan sees him fold it with the rest of the class.

Two children tear their sheets during the activity. They each need another sheet. The extra pile is useful. The teacher agrees to give them fresh paper. Ronan hands it to them.

Jun keeps a small torn piece and folds it into a very tiny book. There is space for one short word inside. He writes big.

Ronan reads it and laughs. He writes small on the outside. Jun puts the little book beside the wide pile. The pile makes his tiny book look even smaller.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sheet＝纸张；count＝数；extra＝多余的。

## 理解问题

1. 小组怎样分配纸张？
2. Ronan的小失误怎样得到真实补救？

## 读句子

**Jun / counts / the sheets.** Jun／数／那些纸。
